On a grey morning after the storm, he found a green bottle wedged between two rocks below the tower. Inside was a page folded small, the ink blurred but readable. Then he sat down to write a reply, unsure where to send it.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没有醒来。路灯在空荡的街口投下昏黄的光，红绿灯独自变换着颜色，没有一辆车理会它。远处传来清洁工扫帚划过地面的沙沙声，像一首很轻的歌。便利店的玻璃门里亮着白光，店员靠着柜台打盹。高楼的窗户大多是黑的，只有零星几盏灯亮着，不知是谁在熬夜，还是谁刚刚醒来。风带着一点凉意，从河面吹进巷子。天边还没有一丝亮色，但空气里已经有了早晨的味道，面包店的烤炉刚刚点燃。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job is solved by doing a smaller copy of the same job.\n- Think of opening a box that has a smaller box inside, and you keep opening until you reach the tiny box that is empty.\n- The empty box is the stopping point, and without it you would open boxes forever."}
